description: A pharmacologic class from the FDA NDF-RT vocabulary as supplied by DrugCentral. Classes describe Mechanism of Action (MoA), Physiologic Effect (PE), Chemical Structure (CS), or Chemical/Ingredient. Other DrugCentral class categories are excluded. Each class is identified by its NDF-RT code and includes at least one represented Compound.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: Stable NDF-RT identifier for the class, such as NDF-RT:N0000000161.

common_properties.name: name
common_properties.description: Human-readable pharmacologic class label supplied by DrugCentral.

common_properties.name: class_type
common_properties.description: Classification category: MoA (Mechanism of Action), PE (Physiologic Effect), CS (Chemical Structure), or Chemical/Ingredient.

common_properties.name: license
common_properties.description: License annotation for the class data: CC BY 4.0.

common_properties.name: url
common_properties.description: BioPortal NDF-RT link for this class.
common_properties.notes: Constructed as `http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/NDFRT/<class_code>` where `<class_code>` is the bare code (e.g. `N0000000161`), not the full CURIE

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing this class; DrugCentral is recorded as DrugCentral.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp of creation or a change to the class name or classification category.

source_contributions.scope: FDA NDF-RT classes in the MoA, PE, CS and Chemical/Ingredient categories, with a non-null class code and at least one associated Compound represented in SPOKE. EPC, PA, has role and EXT categories are excluded.
source_contributions.description: DrugCentral supplies NDF-RT class identities, labels and classification categories, together with class membership of compounds. A class can be represented even when some of its associated compounds are absent.
